row.title: A new gate must read the standards already adopted on main
row.body: OPEN-STANDARDS-1: the openstd gate first accepted only a $schema key, while CONFIG-SCHEMA-1 on main declares config schemas through Schema Store catalogs; the gate now accepts either, so two standards checks do not disagree about the same file. A long-lived branch is reconciled with main before each push, because a day of merges added five checks the branch had never run.

title: A new gate must read the standards already adopted on main
